root_cause: completed product identities were not durably locked across batch transitions
wasted_work_if_repeated: paid generation cost and risk of replacing accepted output
permanent_rule: approved/locked product identities must be excluded before generation planning/execution
enforcement: locked registry + exact identity pre-generation guard

root_cause: verification was treated as permission to rerun
wasted_work_if_repeated: hours of duplicate compute and mutation risk

root_cause: critical state was assembled too late and depended on chat continuity
permanent_rule: rolling durable handoff on every meaningful terminal/checkpoint/head change

root_cause: user was treated as orchestration transport
enforcement: automatic zero-paid continuation + durable next-chat state

root_cause: failure recovery was not scoped to the failing path
wasted_work_if_repeated: duplicate successful work and longer recovery
permanent_rule: read failed job/log, patch affected path only, resume from checkpoint
enforcement: TARGETED_REPAIR + max 3 evidence-supported attempts per signature

root_cause: intermediate state lived only in worker runtime
enforcement: checkpoint/lock persistence before subsequent zero-paid phase

root_cause: chat memory was used as project database
enforcement: GitHub technical handoff + private master context when private storage is available

root_cause: new worker lacked a durable minimal resume contract
permanent_rule: workers start from current_state + rolling_handoff + locks + recent workflows

root_cause: visual/product similarity was at risk of being treated as exact variant proof
permanent_rule: only exact authoritative option-image proof may yield SPECIFIC_VARIANT; otherwise UNKNOWN/CONFLICT

root_cause: generation was allowed to add unsupported product facts/appearance details
wasted_work_if_repeated: false advertising, rejected images, regeneration cost
permanent_rule: NO_UNVERIFIED_FACT; only source-verified facts may be rendered
enforcement: Factual Gate + regression guards + GenerationContext exclusion

root_cause: transport representation lacked durable codec/boundary metadata; repeated decoder probes did not establish authoritative reconstruction
wasted_work_if_repeated: multiple zero-value workflow retries and branch noise
permanent_rule: inspect exact existing bytes/boundaries and provenance first; do not add format guesses without new evidence
enforcement: diagnostic artifact checkpoint + evidence-supported targeted repair only
